body:
@alexpchin If I understand your question correctly,
Yes, it's an existing issue that passing refresh to <InstantSearch> won't automatically send a signal to InfinitHits to clear its cache.
So in the meantime, when you pass true as refresh to <InstantSearch>, you also need to call `cache.clear()`.
There was another problem that `cache.clear()` didn't work because cached hits were once again cached internally in connectInfiniteHits. That's fixed in algolia/react-instantsearch#3011
